name: print-social-cybersecurity-event-flyer-holographic-shield
title: Cybersecurity event flyer with a holographic shield and pill details
whatItIs: A dark navy portrait flyer with the title 'Building Digital Trust' (last word in blue), a subtitle, two pill buttons (Venue, Date & Time) in blue and green, date and location text beneath, and a glossy iridescent 3D shield with a padlock glowing in the corner. Small Google-coloured chevrons float at the edge.
whatItMeans: Techy, secure and community-friendly; the glossy shield makes an abstract topic tangible.
techniques: Illustrate an abstract idea with one glossy 3D object.
Turn key details (venue, date) into colourful pills that resemble UI buttons.
Use one word of the title in a brighter colour for emphasis.
Keep the dark background subtle with small brand-coloured shapes.

vocabulary.definition: A glossy render with rainbow-like reflections.
A rounded label showing event info.
One large object representing the theme.
